text_blocks.snippet: The idea that the Great Wall of China is visible from space is mostly a myth. It cannot be seen from the Moon with the naked eye.
From the International Space Station, about 400 km up, the wall is very difficult to spot without help because it is narrow and blends into the landscape.
Cameras with zoom lenses have captured it, and highways, airports and city lights are far easier to see.

references.title: Is China's Great Wall Visible from Space?
